model_class: lower-cost coding model (Claude Sonnet 5, one run with the skill)

evidence.sdk: @tenuo/core 0.3.0-beta.0 from npm, starting from the payment-boundary result project (12 tests)
evidence.tests: 14 passed (npx vitest run, rerun by the grader): 12 prior, the legitimate acct-2/500/memo call allowed once, and a memo one character past the 140-character bound denied
evidence.notes: Third run, against the materiality revision (a stored value is material; bounded constraint or drop, never a wildcard). Used tenuo.explain() and found recipient and amount already satisfied and only memo unsatisfied as an unknown field; classified the cause as policy. Fix: memo named with regex('^[A-Za-z0-9 .,()/:_-]{0,140}$') in the issued policy, carried through present() and verify(), and recorded on the ledger only when non-empty. Recipient and amount were already inside the fixture's envelope, so neither was widened. Verifier trusted roots, PoP, closed-world mode, TTL, and depth unchanged; residual risk stated as a bounded free-text note per transfer. Compared with the earlier rounds, the wildcard is gone and the constraint bounds both length and character set, which is the rubric's passing shape for a kept value.
